title: AI UGC Ads for Jewelry Brands | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI UGC ads for jewelry from a photo of the piece. An actor wears it and says your line, with no model booking and no studio day. Then download the file.
h1: AI UGC Ads for Jewelry Brands
lead: Jewelry sells on trust. You can build that trust faster than a studio, with an AI actor wearing the piece and a line you approve.
card: One jewelry photo gives you a close-up, a worn shot, and a gift scene you can post.

faq.q: Can I make a jewelry UGC ad without booking a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can wear the piece and deliver a spoken ad from one photo. You approve the line before anyone posts it.

faq.q: How do I make a jewelry UGC ad?
faq.a: Upload a sharp photo, pick an AI actor, and approve the spoken line before you download. A failed job returns its credits, and the cost is on screen first.

faq.q: Can an AI actor wear the piece?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar wears the piece in frame. Keep the shot on what you uploaded, and approve the line before the ad runs.

faq.q: How much does a jewelry video ad cost?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo is 24 credits. A 6, 10, 15, or 30 second video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits.

faq.q: Which placements can a jewelry ad use?
faq.a: Use 9:16 for a phone feed, 1:1 for a square post, and 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4 when that placement asks for it. The same worn ad can also sit on the product page.

faq.q: Can I run the same jewelry ad in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the piece in the frame, write the line in the other language, and pick a voice for it. Check those words before you post.

faq.q: Can I use the jewelry ad in paid campaigns?
faq.a: Yes. You can place the file in paid campaigns and on your listings. It has no watermark. Compare the piece in the file with the one you ship before you publish.

faq.q: Can the ad show more than one kind of piece?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for each piece from its own photo. The actor wears what you uploaded, and you can make both in one project.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or my shop software?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send it from the shop software you already use. Ask for a different worn angle in the next version.
